decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate exchanger line is close to the core offer and benefits from demand for efficient climate control, so its low website visibility since 2019 does not amount to a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The claimed major market share in water cooling systems suggests results at or above aspiration, and with growing turnover and a hiring firm there is slack to carry the line.

The compact oil cooler builds on established competences, and although it has not been visible since 2019, there is no clear evidence of underperformance against aspiration to justify releasing its resources.
The finned tube supports the core air cooler business as a component, so dropping it would weaken an established line rather than free meaningful resources.
The enhanced tubes embody the firm's R&D and efficiency strategy, which fits rising energy-efficiency demand, and available slack allows the firm to keep them while results mature.
